articles.summary: Phase 1 clinical trial of SL-325 enrollment complete; data expected in the second quarter of 2026 – Phase 2 clinical trial of SL-325 in patients with Crohn’s disease expected to initiate in the third quarter of 2026 – AUSTIN, Texas and DURHAM, N.C., May 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Shattuck Labs, Inc. (Shattuck or the Company) (NASDAQ: STTK), a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of potential first-in-class monoclonal and bispecific DR3 blocking antibodies for the treatment of patients with inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases, today reported financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026 and provided recent business highlights. “We are pleased to have completed enrollment in our Phase 1 clinical trial of SL-325, and are looking forward to sharing a comprehensive data set on all single ascending dose and multiple ascending dose cohorts from this study in the second quarter of 2026, including safety and tolerability, pharmacokinetics,
articles.title: Shattuck Labs Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights
